item.title: ai: Serve open models in production with Foundry Managed Compute
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry Managed Compute is now generally available for serving open models in production on dedicated GPUs. It supports Global and US or EU Data Zone deployments.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: MSSQL extension for Visual Studio Code - local-to-cloud deployment wizard
item.description:
The MSSQL extension for Visual Studio Code now includes a public preview wizard for deploying from a local Azure SQL Database container to Azure SQL Database. It supports schema-only or schema-and-data deployment.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: VM adaptive placement
item.description:
Azure VM adaptive placement is in public preview. It can improve VM deployment success when capacity is constrained by allowing Azure to place a VM on an available size instead of failing a create request for one exact size.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: ai: Microsoft Foundry extension for Azure Developer CLI is generally available
item.description:
The Microsoft Foundry extension for Azure Developer CLI is now generally available. It lets you set up, test, evaluate, and deploy hosted agents while keeping agent and deployment configuration with your code.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public preview: Script-based deployment for SQL Server on Linux Azure VM
item.description:
Public preview of a script-based deployment flow for SQL Server on Linux Azure VMs. It replaces legacy marketplace images with automated provisioning and adds more flexibility and customization.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: k8s: Spotlight on SIG Apps
item.description:
SIG Apps is working on workload controller reliability, node lifecycle handling, and new patterns for AI and distributed workloads while preserving backward compatibility. The article highlights current focus areas, the trade-offs in changing core APIs, and a proposed Job API update for Kubernetes 1.38.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog

item.title: dotnet: From dotnet run to Foundry Hosted Agent in 3 lines of C#
item.description:
Microsoft says an agent built with Microsoft Agent Framework can be deployed to Foundry Hosted Agent with 1 NuGet package, 3 lines of C#, and 2 commands.

  • Source: .NET
